qknorm_fp32.change: qknorm_rope_prefill_fp32_kernel: the fast kernel's CTA (32 tokens x 1 head, 256 threads, 8 lanes per head row), loads and stores; FP32 RMSNorm with one in-lane sum (two chains) and three shuffles, NeoX RoPE in FP32 with the RMS scale applied once, no BF16 rounding after RMSNorm or after RoPE, hardware cvt.rn.satfinite.e4m3x2 unless a lane holds |x| > 464 or NaN (then the existing exact NOSAT repair); launch_bounds(256, 5)

sass_cuda_13_4_sm90a.untouched_kernels: every other function of the rope JIT module (fast prefill x4, decode x2, generic x2) compiles to identical instructions; only assert __LINE__ immediates and c[0x4] string offsets move

qknorm_fp32.precision: Not coarser: removes the two intermediate BF16 roundings (an unfused-reference artifact). CPU emulation, 200k rows x 128, weights 0.3-3, random angles: FP8 codes equal to the FP64 result rounded once on 99.99994% (control 95.70%), max 1 step (control 10 steps near zero), relative L2 to FP64 7.2e-5 (control 1.6e-2). V and every NaN/overflow keep control's NOSAT semantics bit for bit.
qknorm_fp32.why_not_the_rejected_layouts: head4, wide and paired rounding kept the instruction count (paired: 763 -> 755 static, 1%); this removes 47% of executed instructions with the same CTA mapping. The QKV-epilogue fusion lost because the same exact arithmetic ran serialized in a 1-CTA/SM GEMM.

dense_schedule.change: deep-gemm overlay patches/deep-gemm-bench/prefill-dense-schedule/sm90-1d2d-prefill-schedule.patch (PP4 config only; not staged into the image build context, not a kernel-bench candidate), active only for Normal GEMMs with N compiled and K at run time (compiled_dims "n") at BLOCK_M 256 with two math warpgroups; SGLANG_PREFILL_DENSE_GEMM=schedule makes prefill_fp8.linear pass "n" for QKV/O. (1) WG1 waits on named barrier 2 before its first WGMMA batch of a tile until WG0 has committed its own, so the two warpgroups' batches run one after the other and each promotes while the other's batch runs; (2) 64-row waves wholly past shape_m issue no WGMMA and no promotion.
dense_schedule.hypothesis: DeepGEMM's 1D2D promotes after warpgroup_wait<0>; leaving the shared full barrier together, the two warpgroups' batches interleave, finish together and both promote (64 FFMA + scales per lane) while the tensor pipes idle: ~100 of every ~512 cycles, consistent with the 81-83% of peak measured for QKV/O. Not verified on GPU.
